info.about:
Come home to the heart of Kathmandu.

Step into a world where Nepal’s timeless heritage meets contemporary comfort. At Basera Boutique Hotel, traditional architecture, warm hospitality, authentic flavors, and refined spaces come together to create more than a stay — they create memories you’ll carry with you.

Stay in heritage. Feel at home. Experience Kathmandu.
info.address: Singh Durbar, Babar Mahal, Kathmandu, Nepal
